title: Matched ch-initial words occur farther right than sh-initial counterparts
statement: Across paragraph lines of at least three tokens, the pooled mean relative interior position of certain ch-initial words with a matching sh-initial spelling is greater than that of the corresponding sh-initial words, with a whole-page bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero.
source: Patrick Feaster (2022), https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-3313/paper12.pdf, reported rightward distributions. This operationalization and direction were examined on public practice pages in P-L2-022 and in the scorer PR; the registration precedes evaluation on hidden pages, but is not a blind preregistration relative to public data. All sections and line lengths are pooled, with no exploratory stratum selected. The matching vocabulary is derived separately within each evaluated sample; this token-weighted pooled difference may reflect page composition rather than a within-page shift. IT is a separate transcription of the same pages, not an independent manuscript sample.
